title: Conformalized Super Learner
abstract: arXiv:2604.22391v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Super Learner (SL) is a widely used ensemble method that combines point predictions from a library of learners based on their predictive performance. Interval predictions are of considerable practical interest because they allow uncertainty in predictions produced by an individual learner or an ensemble to be quantified. Several methods have been proposed for constructing interval predictions based on the SL, however, these approaches are typically justified using asymptotic arguments or rely on computationally intensive procedures such as the bootstrap. Conformal prediction (CP) is a machine learning framework for constructing prediction intervals with finite-sample and asymptotic coverage guarantees under mild conditions. translated_abstract: 超级学习器（SL）是一种广泛使用的集成学习方法，它根据各学习器的预测性能，将来自学习器库中的点预测进行组合。区间预测具有重要的实际意义，因为它能够量化单个学习器或集成模型所产生的预测中的不确定性。目前已提出多种基于SL构建区间预测的方法，然而这些方法通常仅通过渐近性论证来支撑其有效性，或依赖于诸如自助法等计算密集型的程序。保形预测（CP）是一种机器学习框架，能够在温和的条件下构建具有有限样本和渐近覆盖保证的预测区间。我们提出通过一种自然的构造将保形预测与超级学习器相结合，该构造呼应了原始SL框架的设计，利用个体学习器的权重，并通过加权方式组合各学习器特定的保形分数。
tldr: 本文提出将保形预测与超级学习器自然结合的框架，通过加权组合各学习器的保形分数来构建具有有限样本覆盖保证的预测区间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a natural coupling of conformal prediction with the Super Learner, combining learner-specific conformity scores via weighted aggregation to construct prediction intervals with finite-sample coverage guarantees.
